description.en: Generates game art from reference images via Volcengine Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, then assembles eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying. Registers the generation pipeline as agent-callable tools.
description.zh: 基于火山方舟 Seedream 生图与 MiniMax 图生视频生成游戏素材，支持八方向精灵图、单图、序列帧与骨骼动画四个模块，本地完成绿幕抠像与合成，并将生成流水线注册为可被 agent 调用的工具。
